exposure: Women with surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean delivery
Women without SSI after cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who underwent a lower-segment cesarean delivery at Cork University Maternity Hospital, Ireland
finding: Maternal obesity, hypertensive disorders, emergency cesarean delivery, and multiple vaginal examinations were identified as independent risk factors for SSI after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for SSI after cesarean delivery.
